title: Nadezhda Alliluyeva
summary: Nadezhda Alliluyeva (1901–1932) was Joseph Stalin's second wife. According to a reference encyclopedia, she and Stalin argued publicly at a formal dinner on 8 November 1932 and she was found dead the next morning in their apartment, apparently from a self-inflicted gunshot. A 1988 UPI report said Soviet citizens were told publicly for the first time that his behaviour drove her to suicide.

uncertainty.note: Sources differ on the day of death (8 or 9 November 1932).

as_recorded.value: committed suicide in Moscow, USSR, on November 8, 1932
shot herself and died on 9 November 1932, aged 31

importance.justification: Wife of Stalin whose 1932 death was long unconfirmed in Soviet public life.
